greet.text: A traveller! Not many come up the north road these days. I'm Maren - I keep this waystation.

choices.text: Why don't people come this way?
You're not afraid of an orc on your doorstep?
My people still sing of these hills.

greet_again.text: Back again? The kettle's still warm.

choices.text: Tell me about the wolves again.
I'll deal with the Greyfang pack.

wolves.text: The Greyfang pack. They took two carts last month. Riverwatch won't send guards past the old bridge.

accept.text: Truly? Then may the road be kind to you. Their den is past the stone wall, north.

orc_line.text: Orcs pay in coin like anyone else. And you'd be handy against what's out there.

choices.text: Why don't people come this way?

elf_line.text: Then you'll know the old songs warn of wolves. They weren't wrong.
